GTD_Getting_Things_Done.adhd_adjustment: Don't let 'Clarify' become a trap. Spend max 5 mins clarify a single item.

Eat_The_Frog.principle: Do the hardest, most anxiety-inducing task first thing in the morning.
Eat_The_Frog.adhd_adjustment: If the frog is too big, eat a 'tadpole' first to build momentum.

Time_Blocking.principle: Assign every minute of your day to a specific task block.
Time_Blocking.adhd_adjustment: Use 'Day-Theming' instead of minute-blocking to reduce decision fatigue.

Hyperfocus.description: ADHD trait of being absorbed in a task for hours, losing track of time.
Hyperfocus.risk: Neglecting physical needs (food, hydration) and other priorities.
